notes.title: Demo V.0.1.71 Update: New BGM, Korean Localization, We're Going to TGS!
notes.content:
Hello, Interviewers!

We’ve just returned from BitSummit in Kyoto and Coreblazer Fest in Shanghai. Development of the full version has officially begun, and we’re excited to share our latest progress and updates for the Demo!

We’re also thrilled to announce that Thank you for your application has been selected for the 

Tokyo Game Show Selected Indie 80! 

📅 Sep 25–28 | 📍 Makuhari Messe, Chiba (Booth E25) 

Two playable versions will be available on site!


🔥 In Development: Interview Dialogue System
Inspired by Papers, Please, Thank you for your application introduces new dialogue features based on resume-checking mechanics to enhance the interview process. 

We’re working on a tool system that allows interviewers to ask follow-up questions based on specific resume items. Here is the interactive demo of a question tool:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/7ac97a5ad185f6236dec7b48f634f24acf17c8cc.gif"]

Of course, judging criteria varies per job—for example, some prioritize age, others experience. Interviewers must make thoughtful decisions based on context.


🔎In Progress: Interview UX Improvements
We received a lot of valuable UI feedback both at the events and through the survey. We're currently working on improving the overall interaction and layout—for example, the "Call Candidate" action has been updated to a clickable button. This update includes a few of those UI improvements.

As we've now entered full development of the official release, updates to the Demo version may be less frequent due to limited resources. That said, feel free to continue submitting feedback through the survey—we’ll roll out fixes in the next major Demo update.

Thank you so much for trying out the game both online and in person. We were really happy to meet and talk with you at the events. Here are a few photos from the shows:
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/fb656e91bc71f62b089dab67df063154756b08a0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/52d93159d93611a77d7e54b16a53bdd2d66f8e79.jpg"][/carousel]🌐Supported Languages
The Demo currently supports:

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese

English

Japanese

Korean

You can switch languages from the bottom-left corner of the screen.

If you notice any typos, text display issues, or localization mistakes while playing, feel free to let us know via the feedback form or by joining our Discord community.



Thank you so much for your continued support!


Patch Notes V.0.1.71
\[Added]

Interview background music

New apartment tutorial

Korean localization (selectable via start menu)

Panel slide-out animation for the apartment UI

\[Adjusted]

Rebalanced mistake rate probabilities in some interview levels.

Refined dialogue in tutorial sequences.

Improved apartment UI: you can now exit panels by pressing ESC or clicking outside the panel area.

\[Fixed]

Fixed a bug where the title was missing in Day 4's email.

Fixed an issue where tutorial dialogue bubbles were being obscured by UI elements.



Thanks again for your continued support. We'll keep sharing progress through devlogs. Feel free to try the demo anytime! If you'd like to discuss or share feedback on this update, join our official Discord channel to connect with us directly!


>>Feedback Form<<

notes.title: Demo V.0.1.47 Update：Subsidy Mode,Characters animation&We're going to BitSummit!
10 May Update: New Achievements & Development Plan
notes.content:
Hello Interviewers!
We’ve just pushed an update to the playable demo, adding three achievements, and fixing some issues affecting gameplay. Full patch notes are listed at the end.
We’ve also launched the store page for the demo version! If you’d like to share your experience, feel free to leave a review on the demo’s store page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3640210/_Demo/
It’s been almost a week since the demo launched, and we’ve received a great deal of feedback. Thank you so much for your support and encouragement!We’ve carefully read and discussed every comment and suggestion. With this update, we’d also like to share our upcoming development direction.

Interview System Improvements
In future versions, we’ll improve the thank note interaction, hire/reject process, the interviewee call experience, and visual feedback animations.
We’re also planning to add support tools to the UI, and are designing a secondary menu structure.
Better Tutorial
Rules for thank notes, game logic, and system objectives will be presented through more detailed tutorial guidance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/5cde40cbd8b12dc74789e81842bffc0522a547ae.png
Story & Difficulty Expansion
The full version will introduce more chapters and levels.
As interviewers are promoted, the structure of interviews will evolve. Interviewees will have more varied backgrounds and complex profiles. Some characters will return with follow-up storylines.
We’ll also add difficulty settings so players can choose a pace that fits their preference.
Localization
Since English is not our native language, we welcome your feedback on translation errors or unnatural phrasing. Please report issues via Discord or the feedback form — we’ll continue improving localization quality. Thanks for your understanding and support!
Development Direction
Long-time followers may have noticed big changes from our early prototype to the current demo.
Though "interviews" are the starting point, we see this project as a narrative-driven game set in a fictional world, not just a simulation.
As an interviewer, you’ll also live a life after work — and face the realities of identity, systems, and choices.We hope the game provides moments of reflection, beyond its core mechanics.

*We’re glad to see so many people curious about the apartment window view—the scene was actually inspired by Hong Kong!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/9affaf0911bd614bf2029d792298b3738b8e2532.png
We’ll continue to share updates and plans through future development logs.Ongoing improvements to the demo will continue, feel free to try out the latest version anytime—and we’d love it if you could leave a review on the demo’s store page!

Feel free to join our official Discord group to chat directly with us! If you’re interested in games like this, don’t forget to add Thank You for Your Application to your wishlist!

notes.title: "Thank You for Your Application" Demo Now Live!｜MGN Event Preview
notes.content:
Dear Interviewers, thank you for following the development of our game!

 After much job-hunting struggle, we’re excited to announce that the demo of “Thank You for Your Application” is now available, and we’ll be taking part in the MGN Indie Game Carnival from May 1st to May 7th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/6f1463edf21c6d216c952b15c797c457834f6a0b.jpg
What's in the demo?
- Work: In the demo, you’ll join Aeropolis Lab as a Junior Interviewer, tasked with evaluating graduate applicants.
- Stages: As a new employee, you’ll go through a 7-day probation period, with a final evaluation on Day 7.
- Special characters: Several applicants feature branching storylines. Think carefully before making interview decisions — your choices will shape their fates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/886d2c0fc5c2fb613f8a5ab21d9407ac67cf01b6.png
What’s planned for the full version?
In the full release, we plan to introduce additional features such as rank promotions for interviewers, internal staff restructuring, greater diversity among applicants, and narrative choices involving family and personal life. 
Players will uncover the hidden truths behind Aeropolis Lab and the reality of corporate life.
We look forward to growing Thank You for Your Application together with you.

Wishlist and join our community!
We warmly invite you to add Thank You for Your Application to your wishlist and join our Discord to stay up to date with the latest news.

As the game is still in development, you may encounter missing assets or placeholder text in the demo. We kindly ask for your understanding. If you come across any issues that affect your experience, please fill out our Bug Report Form or share your feedback with us directly on Discord. We’ll address any problems as quickly as we can.

We’d also love to hear your thoughts on the demo! After playing, please take a few minutes to complete our Feedback Survey and share your impressions and suggestions.

IceLemonTea Studio

notes.title: Dev Log #1: Gameplay Introduction & Chinese New Year Sale Ongoing
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I’m Ice Lemon Tea, a recent graduate. I’m currently working on the game Thank You for Your Application with a few of my fellow graduates. As Chinese New Year approaches, we’d like to wish you all a happy New Year in advance!
We’re excited to announce that we’re participating in Steam’s Year of the Snake Chinese New Year event, so don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist! This is also a great chance for us to introduce our game and share some of our development plans with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/5f21bfa9957930b9e4e3df83e50b299f2bd74038.jpg
When you see the game title, you can probably already guess that this is a game about interviews. During the autumn and spring recruitment seasons of 2023, I went through 15 rounds of interviews at the same company, only to be rejected in the end. That experience sparked my curiosity about the perspectives of interviewers and companies, which led me to create a game where the tables are turned—I become the interviewer! And that’s how Thank You for Your Application was born.

What does an interviewer do? - Screen CVs, conduct interviews, and reject candidates!
The gameplay is inspired by Papers, Please, Do Not Feed the Monkeys, and Not Tonight. Players will step into the role of an interviewer, using interview software to ask questions, review candidates’ resumes, and eliminate them using appropriate rejection tags. 
Through diverse interview dialogues, the game aims to highlight the harsh realities of job hunting. While the interviewer holds the power to decide candidates’ fates, they must also balance the company’s demands and their own performance metrics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/a10454835dcfb60a704f1b6c50f603af8ac6daf4.gif
What to do after work? - Pay rent, shop, and deal with family.
Beyond the job of conducting interviews, the game also explores the after-work life of a corporate employee. As a heavily discriminated outsider, the interviewer rents a designated apartment for non-locals in the outskirts of Aeropolis City. After work, they must manage high apartment rents and pay for a temporary residence visa. The stress of the job may take a toll on the interviewer’s mental health, so shopping becomes a way to unwind and relieve pressure.
What can you do in your apartment?

 Shop... Unlock hidden items!
 Reply to emails, chat with your family, or engage in some “less-than-legal” communication.
 Browse city forums for interesting posts.
 Admire the view from the edges of the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/bcac0a9245ca6e84d2e9c39b9cef908e02f2df36.gif
Choices for the Interviewer: Someone Else’s Life, My Life, The Gap Between Expectations and Reality
The game features multiple branching endings, where the choices you make as the interviewer, both during work and in your apartment, will influence how the story unfolds. 
The company you work for, Aeropolis Lab, monopolises the city’s production system. The stark contrast between locals and non-locals, along with the omnipresence of intelligent robots, forms the foundation of this futuristic society.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985657/d05499b51a321ee3b5d0deb4e9fc0d738d3a1afe.gif
As an interviewer, while you hold the power to decide candidates’ fates, you’re still just a pawn within a greater system. Through the clash between the perspectives of an interviewer and a worker, we aim to pose deeper questions: What does it mean to be successful? Is the goal we’re striving for truly worth it?

A Demo Is Coming Soon!
Thanks For Your Application has already gone through two rounds of offline testing. Based on the feedback, we’re working to refine the game’s content and aim to release a playable demo soon! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment or join our Discord channel to share your ideas! We’ll also keep you updated with the latest playtest opportunities in the community.
